approaches.name: Sqrt of MSE
approaches.explanation: RMSE and MSE rank models the same way. RMSE is easier to read.

editorial: RMSE = sqrt( (1/n) Σ (y − ŷ)² ). Because square root is monotone, the model that wins on MSE wins on RMSE, but the number is interpretable in target units: an RMSE of 2.0 on house prices in hundreds of thousands of dollars is a typical error of about 200,000 dollars. Outliers still dominate, since the square happens before the root. Use MAE when you want each residual to count linearly.
